test_title: PYST 54: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A cylinder has a total surface area of 2112 cm². Find the radius of the cylinder if its curved surface area is (5)/(12) of total surface area. (Use pi = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

Total surface area of the cylinder = 2112 cm²

Curved surface area = (5/12) × Total surface area

Use π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Total surface area of a cylinder = 2πr(h + r)

Curved surface area = 2πrh

**Calculation:**

Curved surface area = (5/12) × 2112

⇒ Curved surface area = 880 cm²

Curved surface area = 2πrh

⇒ 880 = 2 × (22/7) × r × h

⇒ 880 = (44/7) × r × h

⇒ r × h = (880 × 7) / 44

⇒ r × h = 140

Total surface area = 2πr(h + r)

⇒ 2112 = 2 × (22/7) × r × (h + r)

⇒ 2112 = (44/7) × r × (h + r)

⇒ r × (h + r) = (2112 × 7) / 44

⇒ r × (h + r) = 336

From r × h = 140 and r × (h + r) = 336:

h + r = 336 / r

Substitute h = 140 / r into h + r = 336 / r:

⇒ (140 / r) + r = 336 / r

⇒ 140 + r² = 336

⇒ r² = 336 - 140

⇒ r² = 196

⇒ r = √196

⇒ r = 14 cm

**The radius of the cylinder is 14 cm.**
